sh: headless torso in a t-shirt, arms flailing
f: Forgot its head at home. Still showed up.

sh: big rolling head, messy hair, dizzy eyes
f: Use your head. Literally. As a bowling ball.

sh: giant flat face, wide eyes, goofy grin
f: It is making THAT face at you.

sh: floating eyeball, blue iris, red veins, trailing nerve
f: Always watching. Never blinking. Slightly rude.

sh: one big floppy ear standing on its lobe
f: Hears everything. Tells everyone.

sh: big round nose, two nostrils, sniffing lines
f: Runs without legs. Smells without manners.

sh: floating open mouth, white teeth, flappy tongue
f: All talk. Also all bite.

sh: flying puckered red lips, tiny heart sparks
f: Mwah. Critical hit to your dignity.

sh: shiny white molar with two roots, sparkle
f: Brushed twice a day. Bites all day.

sh: curved pointy fang dripping green venom
f: One tooth. Zero chill.

sh: snapping lower jaw and upper teeth, no face
f: It talks with its mouth full. Of you.

sh: huge heroic square chin with a dimple
f: Can take a punch. Has taken several.

sh: two round rosy cheeks, pinch marks
f: Pinched by aunts since forever.

sh: wide shiny wall of forehead, one raised eyebrow
f: So big it has its own weather.

sh: one thick fuzzy eyebrow wiggling like a caterpillar
f: Raised in suspicion. Launched in anger.

sh: flurry of tiny curved black lashes
f: Make a wish. Then duck.

sh: living mop of long brown hair, no face
f: Bad hair day. For you.

sh: huge bushy beard with a hidden bird nest
f: Things go in. Things do not come out.

sh: curly handlebar mustache flapping like wings
f: Instantly 40% more distinguished.

sh: long stretchy neck swinging like a whip
f: Sticking it out for you.

sh: dark red swallowing tunnel, dangly uvula
f: GULP. Gone.

sh: padded shoulder barging forward, speed lines
f: Excuse me. Pardon me. WHAM.

sh: one long swinging arm, flexed bicep
f: Costs an arm. The leg is extra.

sh: snapping wrist with a gold bracelet flash
f: It is all in the wrist. Everything is.

sh: giant hand walking on its fingers
f: Need a hand? Too late, it is yours now.

sh: giant pointing finger, poke lines
f: Poke. Poke. Poke. Poke. Poke.

sh: giant thumbs-up with a sparkle
f: Certified approved. Now squish.

sh: four big knuckles between two bread slices
f: A sandwich nobody orders twice.

sh: spray of little crescent nail clippings
f: Clipped and launched. Ew, effective.

sh: big round bouncy belly with a belly button
f: Rumbles before it rolls.

sh: small swirly navel with lint floating in
f: Where lost socks' lint retires.

sh: broad turned back with a backpack strap
f: It has got yours.

sh: swinging hip in jeans with impact star
f: Bump! Out of the way, dance floor is mine.

sh: spinning waist twirling a pink hula hoop
f: Hoops around you until you are dizzy.

sh: round cartoon bottom in blue jeans, bounce lines
f: Butt bump of destiny.

sh: one hopping leg in jeans and a sneaker
f: Break a leg! No, not that one.

sh: bent knee with a bandage flying forward
f: Scraped a hundred times. Never scared.

sh: tiny snappy thing nipping at sock height
f: Small. Angry. Sock-level.

sh: giant bare foot dropping from above, wiggly toes
f: Comes down from the sky. Smells like it too.

sh: one red throbbing big toe, pain stars
f: This little piggy went to WAR.

sh: red high-heel shoe stabbing downward
f: Clack clack clack. That is the sound of doom.

sh: stretchy sheet of skin with goosebumps
f: Your largest organ. Now your largest shield.

sh: classic cartoon bone, knobbly ends, spinning
f: Throw it. Every dog in range betrays its owner.

sh: grinning skull, dark sockets, chattering jaw
f: Alas, poor you.

sh: pink wrinkly brain floating, psychic rings
f: Big brain time. Finally.

sh: plump red heart thumping, pulse rings
f: Ba-dum. Ba-dum. Ba-DOOM.

sh: pair of pink lungs inflating like bellows
f: Deep breath in. Everybody out.

sh: wobbly dark red wedge, grumpy face
f: Filters everything. Enjoys nothing.

sh: pair of bean-shaped kidneys bouncing
f: Comes in pairs. Like trouble.

sh: huge flexing arm, bulging bicep, sweat sparkle
f: Do you even type, bro?

sh: bright red cartoon splat with shiny highlights
f: Relax. It is probably ketchup.

sh: branching blue and red tubes pulsing
f: The scenic route for blood.

sh: jagged yellow nerve line crackling with sparks
f: You are getting on it. The last one.

sh: big wobbly blue teardrops falling
f: Cry me a river. Then surf it.

sh: stretchy green goo blob with drippy strings
f: Pick a card. Wait, that is not a card.

sh: upside-down smile shape under a tiny rain cloud
f: Turn it upside down. Still mad.

sh: pair of white feathered wings flapping, no body
f: Just wings. Body sold separately.

sh: fluffy wagging tail swishing side to side
f: Wags when happy. Whacks when not.

sh: big fluffy cat paw, pink toe beans, tiny claws
f: Boop. You have been booped.

sh: dark horse hoof with a shiny horseshoe
f: Clip. Clop. Clobber.

sh: branching tan antlers, many points
f: Nature's coat rack. Pointier.

sh: sharp orange beak pecking forward rapidly
f: Peck peck peck. Mind your fries.

sh: puffy tumbling cloud of shed pet fur
f: On your clothes forever now.

sh: flat bathroom scale, needle spinning wildly
f: It judges. Silently. With numbers.

sh: grey triangle fin slicing through a water ripple
f: Dun dun. Dun dun. DUN DUN.

sh: purple tentacle rising from a puddle, pink suckers
f: It just wants a hug. A long one.

sh: long curved ivory tusk, pointed tip
f: Pointy end first. Always.

sh: fan of long white twitching whiskers
f: Senses danger. Is the danger.

sh: huge golden fluffy mane ring, no lion inside
f: All the drama. None of the lion.

sh: pink pig snout, two round nostrils, snuffling
f: Sniffs out snacks at 500 paces.

sh: round sandy hump with a tuft of hair
f: Storing snacks for later. And for war.

sh: tiny black barbed needle with a yellow base
f: Small poke. Big regret.

sh: big red snapping crab claw, no crab
f: Pinch, punch, first of the month.

sh: big silver spiral spiderweb with dew drops
f: Sticky situation. Literally.

sh: twig bowl with three speckled eggs and an angry beak
f: Mama bird is home. And furious.

sh: red bump with a yellow top, ready to pop
f: Do not pop it. DO NOT. Oh no.

sh: crusty brown patch, edges peeling
f: Do not pick it. You are picking it.

sh: purple-green blotch that throbs
f: Comes in every colour of ouch.

sh: jagged pink scar line with stitch marks
f: You should see the other guy.

sh: cartoon scrape with a crossed bandage on it
f: Needs a kiss better. And a plaster.

sh: puffy pale bubble on red skin
f: New shoes did this.

sh: bumpy green lump with one hair
f: A gift from a toad. No returns.

sh: sprinkle of tiny brown dots raining down
f: Sun kisses. Now in bulk.

sh: cute smile dent with a sparkle
f: Weaponised cuteness, pocket size.

sh: wavy fold lines rippling across everything
f: Adds eighty years in one second.

sh: inky dragon drawing peeling off skin and flying
f: Says MOM in a heart. Bites anyway.

sh: two fuzzy cheek strips spinning like boomerangs
f: Business in the front. Fuzz on the sides.

sh: long swishing ponytail with a pink scrunchie
f: Head turn. Whip crack. Oops, sorry.

sh: thick woven blond braid with a red bow, lasso loop
f: Rapunzel called. She wants her rope back.

sh: tall spiky green hair fin with pink tips
f: Hair so sharp it needs a licence.

sh: giant round fluffy afro with a comb stuck in
f: Absorbs impacts and compliments.

sh: shiny bald head with a blinding glint
f: So shiny it reflects lasers. And dreams.

sh: snipping scissors and comb, hair bits flying
f: Just a little off the top. Oops.

sh: raised arm with wavy green stink lines
f: Deodorant was optional. Regret is not.

sh: elbow bone buzzing with tingly zigzags
f: Not funny. Never was. Tingles though.

sh: lower leg swinging at exactly table-corner height
f: Finds every coffee table in the dark.

sh: mighty leg-day thigh stomping forward
f: Never skipped leg day. Not once.

sh: yellow bird foot with four hooked black claws
f: Grabs first. Asks never.

sh: puff of wavy green breath with stink lines
f: Garlic for breakfast. Regret for everyone.

sh: grown-up with crossed arms, car keys, raised eyebrow
f: Because I said so. That is why.

sh: smirking kid holding your stuff just out of reach
f: Stop copying me. Stop copying me.

sh: boy with a backwards cap and scraped knees
f: Was told not to run indoors. Is running.

sh: girl with pigtails, rain boots, a determined glare
f: Asked nicely once. Just once.

sh: kid in a striped shirt with a slingshot in his pocket
f: Found a stick. It is a sword now.

sh: kid with a ponytail, sneakers and a jump rope whip
f: Fights like a girl. So, wins.

sh: ordinary guy in a polo shirt holding a coffee
f: Will not ask for directions. Ever.

sh: woman with a tote bag swung like a flail
f: The handbag weighs nine kilos. Run.

sh: laid-back dude, flip-flops, shades, shaka hand
f: Duuude. Not cool. Now it is on.

sh: tired adult in a suit holding bills and a mug
f: Has a meeting about this at four.

sh: kid in a holiday sweater wielding a game controller
f: Visits twice a year. Breaks your stuff both times.

sh: small boy with a toy dinosaur and sticky hands
f: Why? Why? But why? Why though?

sh: small girl covered in glitter with a marker pen
f: Drew on the walls. Calls it a gift.

sh: grinning kid giving a high five, friendship bracelet
f: Has your back. Also has your snacks.

sh: scowling figure in a dark coat, pointing dramatically
f: We meet again. As I planned. Mostly.

sh: figure in a trench coat and hat, face in shadow
f: Nobody knows who invited them.

sh: plain person waving, jeans and trainers
f: Mostly water. Entirely opinions.

sh: generic stick-figure-like person with a name tag
f: Just some person. Really committed though.

sh: dense pack of cheering people with signs and foam fingers
f: Excuse me. Sorry. Coming through. All of us.

sh: parents, kids, grandma and a dog in matching sweaters
f: Loud. Embarrassing. Unbeatable together.

sh: man in a barbecue apron holding tongs and a ring
f: Could not find it. It was right there.

sh: woman with a ring, hands on hips, knowing look
f: She was right. She is always right.

sh: white gown, veil, bouquet held like a mace
f: Throws the bouquet at 90 miles an hour.

sh: teen with flowers behind his back, nervous grin
f: Texted back in under a minute. A hero.

sh: teen with a phone, heart sticker, one raised brow
f: We need to talk. Four scariest words.

sh: grandma and grandpa arm in arm, cookies and a cane
f: Spoil you rotten. Rivals, though? Destroyed.

sh: tiny kid in a hand-knitted sweater three sizes too big
f: Gets cookies just for existing.

sh: grown-up with a packed lunch and a minivan key
f: Bonus parent. Extra snacks unlocked.

sh: kid dividing a bedroom with a strip of tape
f: This side is mine. That side is also mine.

sh: kindly grown-up with a wrapped gift and a wink
f: Shows up with presents and suspicious timing.

sh: kid with a backpack flicking paper balls
f: Can I copy your homework? Thanks. Bye.

sh: person in pajamas eating your labelled leftovers
f: Ate your food. Left one bite. As a message.

sh: player in a matching jersey calling for the pass
f: Says "I got it". Does not got it.

sh: buddy standing back to back with you, finger guns
f: Howdy, pardner. Dibs on the left ones.

sh: loyal fighter with a blue banner and a raised shield
f: Reinforcements have arrived. Fashionably late.

sh: blushing figure with heart eyes and a love letter
f: Wrote your name in a heart. On everything.

sh: person with a box of your stuff and folded arms
f: Still has your hoodie. Not giving it back.

sh: cap and gown, hurling a square hat like a disc
f: Four years for a hat. Throws it immediately.

sh: lost kid with a giant backpack and a campus map
f: Looking for room 204. Has been since Monday.

sh: tiny kid with a paint-smeared smock and juice box
f: Nap time is over. Chaos time begins.

sh: kid with a headset and controller, floating P1 arrow
f: Press start. Regret nothing.

sh: hero holding a gold trophy overhead, title belt
f: Undefeated. Mostly because of the trophy swing.

sh: grumpy kid flipping a game board, pieces flying
f: Best two out of three? Out of five? Seven?

sh: commander pointing forward, cape, feathered hat
f: Follow me! Wait, which way were we going?

sh: tidy helper with a silver tray and white gloves
f: You rang? I brought snacks and a shield.

sh: officer in a peaked cap with medals and a pointing stick
f: Atten-SHUN! That means you, typing fingers.

sh: tough trooper wading ashore, helmet and pack
f: First ones in. Last ones to stop yelling.

sh: rows of marching soldiers with flags and helmets
f: Left. Left. Left right left. All of them.

sh: five soldiers in a wedge formation, one with a radio
f: Squad up. Somebody brought snacks, right?

sh: shield wall of red-cloaked soldiers with spears and standard
f: A thousand shields. One very long queue.

sh: ragtag villagers with pitchforks, pans and one drum
f: Farmers by day. Also farmers at night, but angry.

sh: towering armoured figure with a glowing tower shield
f: You shall not get past. Or even near.

sh: tripod gun post with a red scanning eye and beeping light
f: Halt. Who goes there? Never mind. Pew.

sh: tall still guardian with a spear and one glowing eye slit
f: Has not blinked since the last update.

sh: black suit, sunglasses, earpiece, tiny gadget pen
f: The name is classified. So is the snack.

sh: three officers, flashing lights, whistles, a donut box
f: Wee-woo wee-woo. You are under a-typed.

sh: generic leader at a podium with a flag pin and bodyguards
f: My fellow summons. Vote bonk.

sh: official in a grey suit buried in paperwork
f: Will form a committee about your attack.

sh: person in a cap gripping a wheel, tiny car around them
f: Learned to drive in a video game. It shows.

sh: performer with a guitar on back and drumsticks in hand
f: One, two, three, four! Solo of doom.

sh: tall chess piece with a notched round top
f: Only moves diagonally. Good luck dodging.

sh: fast talker with a suitcase of gadgets and a huge grin
f: But wait, there is more! There is always more.

sh: person with a huge key ring and a rent-due notice
f: Rent is due. It is always due.

sh: person on a couch surrounded by moving boxes
f: Not moving out. Not moving at all.

sh: hi-vis vest, hard hat, lunch box, shovel
f: Clocked in. On a break. Clocked out.

sh: nervous youngster carrying six coffees and a lanyard
f: Unpaid. Unstoppable. Slightly unsure.

sh: person at a desk with a headset, flinging sticky notes
f: Do you have an appointment? Thought not.

sh: beret, megaphone, folding chair, clapperboard
f: CUT! Do it again, but with more dying.

sh: suit with sunglasses, two phones and a briefcase of cash
f: Loves it. Change everything.

sh: person with a giant red pen crossing things out
f: Too long. Cut the enemy by half.

sh: lab coat, butterfly net, jar with something wriggling
f: Fascinating! It is biting me. Fascinating!

sh: tweed jacket, dusty scroll, pointing at a timeline
f: Actually, this battle already happened in 1066.

sh: toga, long beard, chin on fist, thought bubble
f: But what IS a hit point, really?

sh: see-through elder in old robes, glowing softly
f: Watching over you. Mildly disappointed.

sh: scrappy kid in a patched cap holding an empty bowl
f: Please, may I have some more enemies?

sh: bandana, patched jacket, raised fist, makeshift banner
f: Refuses to follow the tutorial.

sh: pinstripe suit, fedora, violin case, toothpick
f: Nice base you got here. Shame if it got typed on.

sh: hooded purple robe, candle, chanting mouth only
f: Have you heard the good news about the void?

sh: person tied to a chair hopping along, mouthing help
f: Mmmph! Mmph mmph! (Translation: behind you!)

sh: unlucky fellow under a tiny rain cloud with a target sign
f: Wrong place. Wrong time. Every time.

sh: ragged tough figure with a pan, backpack and a bandaged arm
f: Eaten worse. Fought worse. Slept in worse.

sh: traveller with a bundle, blanket and a small lantern
f: Carrying everything that matters. Still shares.

sh: ordinary passer-by with shopping bags and a phone
f: Just popping to the shops. Oh. A battle.

sh: sailors hauling a rope together, striped shirts
f: All hands on deck! Some feet too.

sh: huddle of players in red jerseys with a mascot
f: There is no I in team. There is a me, though.

sh: five toughs in matching leather jackets, snapping fingers
f: Snap, snap, snap. Menacing choreography.

sh: group in matching tartan with a banner and war drums
f: Mess with one, meet all forty cousins.

sh: knight, mage, archer and healer under a guild banner
f: Looking for group. Must have own sword.

sh: top hat, monocle, cane, tea cup, perfect posture
f: I say. Fisticuffs it is, then.

sh: mismatched socks, colander hat, walking a pet rock
f: Normal is a setting on a washing machine.

sh: scowling kid sticking out tongue, arms crossed
f: Took your turn. Took your seat. Took your juice.

sh: shifty kid whose pants are a little bit on fire
f: Pants: on fire. Nose: getting longer.

sh: trembling kid hiding behind own hands, knees knocking
f: Runs away so fast it counts as an attack.

sh: taped glasses, pocket protector, armful of comics
f: Um, actually, that is a common misconception.

sh: grinning goof in a pointy paper hat walking into a wall
f: Tried to push a pull door. For an hour.

sh: grinning kid with a slingshot, whoopee cushion and matches
f: Did not do it. Nobody saw. Cannot prove it.

sh: huge no-neck heavy with tiny head and cracking knuckles
f: Thinking is hard. Smashing is easy.

sh: dreamy kid shuffling along tying one shoelace forever
f: Will arrive by Thursday. Maybe.

sh: kid with hand rocketing up, shiny apple, perfect hair
f: Teacher! Teacher! They are cheating!

sh: two guards walking a loop with lanterns and whistles
f: Round and round. Nothing to see. Oh wait.

sh: stout armoured guard with a giant key and a crossed halberd
f: What is the password? Wrong. It is always wrong.
